headline.en: Atrium Launches Platform Tracking $1.3T of US Data Center Development Credit
headline.zh: Atrium 推出平台，追踪 1.3 万亿美元美国数据中心开发信贷

summary.en: Atrium, a San Diego-based AI analytics startup founded in 2024, launched an interactive data and research platform called "Who Finances America's Data Centers." The platform tracks debt behind data center deals, covering $1.3 trillion of identifiable debt across commercial loans, CMBS, syndications and corporate debt. It covers 3,038 operational data center deals and another 1,258 in different stages of their lifecycles.
summary.zh: 总部位于圣迭戈、成立于2024年的人工智能分析初创公司 Atrium 推出了名为“Who Finances America's Data Centers”的互动数据与研究平台。该平台追踪数据中心交易背后的债务，覆盖商业贷款、CMBS、银团贷款和企业债务中1.3万亿美元的可识别债务。平台涵盖3,038笔运营中的数据中心交易以及另外1,258笔处于不同生命周期阶段的交易。

headline.en: Australian investors commit A$705m to Arcmont European direct lending
headline.zh: 澳大利亚投资者向Arcmont欧洲直接贷款承诺7.05亿澳元

summary.en: Brighter Super, Jana Private Credit Trust and two other Australian institutional investors committed a combined A$705m (£372.6m) to a dedicated portfolio managed by Arcmont Asset Management, an affiliate of Nuveen. The strategy will invest in senior-secured, unitranche and subordinated loans to European mid and upper-mid-market companies, focused on non-cyclical, defensive sectors. Arcmont has A$74bn of investable capital.
summary.zh: Brighter Super、Jana Private Credit Trust以及另外两家澳大利亚机构投资者共同承诺7.05亿澳元（3.726亿英镑），投入由Nuveen旗下Arcmont Asset Management管理的专项投资组合。该策略将投资于欧洲中型及中上型市场公司的高级担保贷款、unitranche和次级贷款，聚焦非周期性防御性行业。Arcmont拥有740亿澳元的可投资资本。

headline.en: BasePoint Group files 13D reporting 26.8% stake in Katapult Holdings
headline.zh: BasePoint Group 提交 13D 文件，披露持有 Katapult Holdings 26.8% 股份

summary.en: BasePoint Group Inc. filed a Schedule 13D reporting a 26.8% stake in Katapult Holdings. The filing lists Katapult's SIC classification as services-equipment rental and leasing.
summary.zh: BasePoint Group Inc. 提交了 Schedule 13D 文件，披露持有 Katapult Holdings 26.8% 的股份。文件列示 Katapult 的 SIC 分类为服务—设备租赁与出租。

headline.en: Onex fee-generating AUM hits $43.2bn amid active CLO quarter
headline.zh: Onex 收费管理资产规模达 432 亿美元，CLO 业务季度活跃

summary.en: Onex reported total fee-generating assets under management of approximately $43.2bn at the end of the second quarter, with Onex Credit fee-generating AUM at $30.6bn, up from $29.8bn at end-2025. The credit business raised or extended three CLO transactions representing $1.4bn in fee-generating AUM, and structured credit posted its highest-ever quarterly fee-related earnings of $19m. Credit investments generated a net loss of $5m versus a $33m net gain a year earlier.
summary.zh: Onex 报告第二季度末总收费管理资产规模约为 432 亿美元，其中 Onex Credit 收费管理资产规模为 306 亿美元，高于 2025 年底的 298 亿美元。其信贷业务新增或展期三笔 CLO 交易，带来 14 亿美元收费管理资产规模，结构化信贷季度费用相关收益创下 1900 万美元的历史新高。信贷投资净亏损 500 万美元，而去年同期为净收益 3300 万美元。

headline.en: BridgeInvest raises over $612m for US speciality real estate credit fund
headline.zh: BridgeInvest为美国专业房地产信贷基金募集逾6.12亿美元

summary.en: BridgeInvest has raised more than $612m for its BridgeInvest Specialty Credit Fund V, an open-ended vehicle targeting senior-secured, middle-market US commercial real estate debt. The Miami-based manager has invested across 21 senior-secured commercial real estate credit investments since the fund launched a year ago, and expects limited partner commitments to exceed $1bn by 2027. BridgeInvest manages more than $1.4bn in assets and closed $780m in loan transactions in 2025.
summary.zh: BridgeInvest已为其BridgeInvest Specialty Credit Fund V募集逾6.12亿美元，该开放式基金瞄准美国中端市场的高级担保商业房地产债务。这家总部位于迈阿密的基金管理公司自该基金一年前成立以来，已投资21笔高级担保商业房地产信贷。BridgeInvest预计到2027年有限合伙人承诺出资将超过10亿美元。该公司管理资产超过14亿美元，2025年完成7.8亿美元的贷款交易。

headline.en: Blue Owl Finance prices $750 million 6.750% senior notes due 2036
headline.zh: Blue Owl Finance 为 2036 年到期的 6.750% 优先票据定价 7.5 亿美元

summary.en: Blue Owl Finance LLC, an indirect subsidiary of Blue Owl Capital Inc., is offering $750 million aggregate principal amount of 6.750% senior notes due 2036. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed on a joint and several basis by Blue Owl Capital Inc. and other guarantor entities. Net proceeds are intended to repay a portion of outstanding borrowings under the company's revolving credit facility.
summary.zh: Blue Owl Capital Inc. 的间接子公司 Blue Owl Finance LLC 发行本金总额 7.5 亿美元、2036 年到期的 6.750% 优先票据。该票据由 Blue Owl Capital Inc. 及其他担保实体以连带方式提供全额无条件担保。募集资金净额拟用于偿还公司循环信贷额度下的部分未偿借款。

headline.en: Cheyne Capital raises £3bn for ninth real estate lending fund
headline.zh: Cheyne Capital 第九只房地产贷款基金募资 30 亿英镑

summary.en: Cheyne Capital raised £3bn at final close for its ninth real estate lending vintage, the CRECH IX - Capital Solutions fund, across the commingled fund and adjacent vehicles. The fund has deployed over 50% of committed capital and holds 73 underlying loans, with 16 realised, spanning eight European countries. Cheyne said lending volume from 2023 to 2025 exceeded €6bn.
summary.zh: Cheyne Capital 第九只房地产贷款基金 CRECH IX - Capital Solutions 完成最终关闭，在混合基金及关联工具中共募资 30 亿英镑。该基金已部署超过 50% 的承诺资本，旗下持有 73 笔底层贷款，其中 16 笔已实现退出，覆盖八个欧洲国家。Cheyne 表示 2023 年至 2025 年三年间贷款投放规模超过 60 亿欧元。

headline.en: Arrow Global FUM jumps to over €15bn
headline.zh: Arrow Global管理资产规模跃升至逾150亿欧元

summary.en: Arrow Global's funds under management rose to €15.5bn at the end of the second quarter of 2026, up €4.8bn or 44 per cent year-on-year, driven by its credit strategy. The European asset manager's credit strategy gathered €5.2bn of commitments over the last 12 months, and Arrow deployed €1.7bn in the first half of 2026.
summary.zh: 截至2026年第二季度末，Arrow Global的管理资产规模升至155亿欧元，同比增长48亿欧元，增幅44%，主要受其信贷策略推动。这家欧洲资产管理公司的信贷策略在过去12个月募集了52亿欧元的承诺资金，Arrow在2026年上半年部署了17亿欧元。

headline.en: BlackRock HPS Corporate Lending Fund redemption requests ease to 11.5% in Q3
headline.zh: BlackRock旗下HPS Corporate Lending Fund第三季度赎回请求降至11.5%

summary.en: Redemption requests at BlackRock's HPS Corporate Lending Fund fell to around 11.5 per cent of shares in the third quarter, down from 13.3 per cent in Q2, according to a regulatory filing. The non-traded business development company will repurchase around 5 per cent of its outstanding shares, or approximately $600m, in line with its quarterly tender offer limit, with the price based on net asset value as of 30 September.
summary.zh: 根据一份监管文件，BlackRock旗下HPS Corporate Lending Fund第三季度的赎回请求降至约11.5%的份额，低于第二季度的13.3%。这家非上市业务发展公司将按季度要约收购上限回购约5%的流通份额，即约6亿美元，价格基于9月30日的资产净值。

headline.en: CPP Investments posts strongest quarter in over a decade on real assets and credit
headline.zh: CPP Investments 凭借实物资产和信贷创下十多年来最强季度表现

summary.en: CPP Investments reported its strongest quarterly investment performance in more than a decade for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, ending 30 June 2026 with net assets of C$863.6bn, up from C$793.3bn. Net income of C$60.2bn and C$10.1bn in net transfers drove a C$70.3bn increase, with a 7.5 per cent quarterly net return and a 9.4 per cent 10-year annualised net return. Credit commitments during the quarter included US$1bn to Blackstone Private Credit Fund and approximately €270m to finance a portfolio of European corporate loans originated by an Ares Management fund.
summary.zh: CPP Investments 公布 2027 财年第一季度为十多年来最强季度投资表现，截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日净资产为 8636 亿加元，高于上一季度末的 7933 亿加元。602 亿加元的净收益和 101 亿加元的净转移推动净资产增加 703 亿加元，季度净回报率为 7.5%，10 年年化净回报率为 9.4%。本季度的信贷承诺包括向 Blackstone Private Credit Fund 提供的 10 亿美元，以及约 2.7 亿欧元用于为由 Ares Management 旗下一只基金发起的欧洲企业贷款组合提供融资。

headline.en: Neuberger launches New Bridge Aero aerospace financing platform targeting $2bn portfolio
headline.zh: Neuberger 推出 New Bridge Aero 航空金融平台，目标组合规模超 20 亿美元

summary.en: Neuberger Specialty Finance has launched New Bridge Aero, an aerospace financing platform aiming to build a portfolio in excess of $2bn. The platform will originate and acquire aerospace loans and other debt instruments offering downside protection and durable cash flows, and will be led by Richard Moody with Debbie Frew and William Glaister as co-founders and principals. Neuberger Specialty Finance is the asset-based finance arm of Neuberger and manages over $5bn across more than 50 portfolio companies.
summary.zh: Neuberger Specialty Finance 推出了航空金融平台 New Bridge Aero，目标是构建规模超过 20 亿美元的投资组合。该平台将发起并收购航空航天领域的贷款及其他债务工具，力求提供下行保护和稳定的现金流，由 Richard Moody 领导，Debbie Frew 和 William Glaister 担任联合创始人兼负责人。Neuberger Specialty Finance 是 Neuberger 的资产支持金融部门，管理着超过 50 家投资组合公司中逾 50 亿美元的资产。

headline.en: Janus Henderson AAA CLO ETF reaches $30bn in assets
headline.zh: Janus Henderson AAA CLO ETF资产规模达300亿美元

summary.en: Janus Henderson Investors' AAA CLO ETF (JAAA) has reached $30bn in assets under management, the firm said. The manager also reported $5.7bn in year-to-date inflows into the vehicle, which was launched in 2020. Janus Henderson said it has more than $70bn in firm-wide securitised assets.
summary.zh: Janus Henderson Investors表示，其AAA CLO ETF（JAAA）资产规模已达300亿美元。该管理人还报告称，该基金今年以来资金流入达57亿美元；该基金于2020年推出。Janus Henderson称其全公司证券化资产规模超过700亿美元。

headline.en: Northleaf asset-based specialty finance fund closes at $450m
headline.zh: Northleaf 资产支持专业金融基金以 4.5 亿美元完成募集

summary.en: Northleaf Capital Partners has raised approximately $450m for its inaugural Northleaf Asset-Based Specialty Finance Fund at final close. The amount includes commitments to the fund and co-investment vehicles investing alongside it. The strategy targets entertainment royalties, legal assets, healthcare receivables and factoring across the US, Canada, Europe and Australia.
summary.zh: Northleaf Capital Partners 为其首只 Northleaf Asset-Based Specialty Finance Fund 完成最终募集，募资约 4.5 亿美元。该金额包括对该基金及与其共同投资的联合投资工具的承诺出资。该策略瞄准娱乐版税、法律资产、医疗应收账款和保理等专业资产领域，投资范围覆盖美国、加拿大、欧洲和澳大利亚。

headline.en: CRE CLO Distress Rate Jumps to 28% in August
headline.zh: 8月CRE CLO不良率跃升至28%

summary.en: The commercial real estate CLO distress rate rose from 19% in July to 28% in August, the sharpest one-month move of any deal type this year, per CRED iQ. SASB distress held near 22% since June, with both concentrated in 2021-2022 vintage loans; the FSRIA 2021-FL3 deal alone has $353 million of multifamily collateral in special servicing.
summary.zh: 据CRED iQ数据，商业地产CLO（CRE CLO）不良率从7月的19%升至8月的28%，为今年各类交易中单月最大涨幅。SASB不良率自6月以来维持约22%，两者均集中于2021和2022年份贷款；仅FSRIA 2021-FL3一笔交易就有3.53亿美元多户住宅抵押品处于特别服务状态。

headline.en: CBRE Investment Management Acquires $1.6B Net-Lease Portfolio
headline.zh: CBRE Investment Management 收购 16 亿美元净租赁资产组合

summary.en: CBRE Investment Management acquired Tenet Equity's $1.6 billion net-lease platform, comprising 208 assets in 39 states and 12 million square feet. The portfolio is fully leased to middle-market industrial tenants with an average lease term of roughly 17 years, and Tenet Equity will remain an operating partner. Truist Securities advised CBRE Investment Management on the transaction.
summary.zh: CBRE Investment Management 收购了 Tenet Equity 价值 16 亿美元的净租赁平台，包含分布在 39 个州的 208 项资产，面积达 1200 万平方英尺。该资产组合已全部出租给中型工业企业租户，平均租期约为 17 年，Tenet Equity 将继续担任运营合作伙伴。Truist Securities 为 CBRE Investment Management 的此次交易提供顾问服务。

headline.en: CMBS Distress Approaches Peak as Office Hits Record 8.89%
headline.zh: 办公楼困境率达创纪录的8.89%，CMBS困境逼近峰值

summary.en: CMBS distress has steadily risen and is approaching a peak, with office distress hitting an all-time high of 8.89 percent in July. Trepp found that of the $65 billion in CMBS loans maturing by the end of 2026, $37 billion are hard maturities with no extension options, and PropertyChecker said 39 percent of the year's hard maturities fall in the fourth quarter. Views on the significance differ, with Trepp calling the maturity wall "specific pockets of refinance pressure" while others see a more serious maturity wall.
summary.zh: CMBS困境率持续上升并逼近峰值，7月办公楼困境率创下8.89%的历史新高。Trepp发现，在2026年底前到期的650亿美元CMBS贷款中，有370亿美元是无展期选项的硬到期；PropertyChecker称，今年硬到期的39%集中在第四季度。各方对这一问题的重要性看法不一，Trepp称这堵到期墙更像是“特定的再融资压力口袋”，而另一些人则认为到期墙问题更为严重。

headline.en: Goldman Sachs Alternatives tops $10bn for European evergreen private credit strategy
headline.zh: Goldman Sachs Alternatives 欧洲常青私募信贷策略资产突破100亿美元

summary.en: Goldman Sachs Alternatives has surpassed $10bn in assets for its evergreen European private credit strategy, launched in October 2023 within its European senior direct lending platform. The strategy invests alongside the firm's flagship closed-ended senior direct lending funds and holds exposure to more than 400 companies, including private credit loans to over 100 firms.
summary.zh: Goldman Sachs Alternatives 的欧洲常青私募信贷策略资产规模已突破100亿美元，该策略于2023年10月在其欧洲优先直接贷款平台下推出。该策略与公司旗舰封闭式优先直接贷款基金系列共同投资，目前投资组合覆盖逾400家公司，其中包括对100多家企业的私募信贷贷款。

headline.en: Prospect Ridge closes second real estate credit fund at $800 million
headline.zh: Prospect Ridge 第二只房地产信贷基金完成募集，规模8亿美元

summary.en: Prospect Ridge has closed its second commercial real estate credit fund with $800 million in capital commitments. The vehicle, Prospect Ridge Real Estate Debt Fund II, has roughly $3 billion of total lending capacity and will make first-mortgage loans, mezzanine loans and preferred equity investments across the U.S. It follows the firm's debut $500 million fund.
summary.zh: Prospect Ridge 已完成其第二只商业房地产信贷基金的募集，获得8亿美元资本承诺。该基金名为 Prospect Ridge Real Estate Debt Fund II，总贷款能力约为30亿美元，将在美国各地进行第一抵押贷款、夹层贷款和优先股投资。此前该公司的首只基金规模为5亿美元。

headline.en: Crescent Capital closes second CLO equity fund at $232m
headline.zh: Crescent Capital 第二只 CLO 股权基金以 2.32 亿美元完成募集

summary.en: Crescent Capital has raised $232m at the final close of its second CLO equity fund, Crescent CLO Equity Funding II. The fund doubled the size of its 2018 predecessor, Crescent CLO Equity Funding I, which closed with $103m in commitments. The fund will invest in control positions of Crescent CLOs and opportunistically in debt of its own vehicles and third-party CLOs.
summary.zh: Crescent Capital 第二只 CLO 股权基金 Crescent CLO Equity Funding II 完成最终募集，募资 2.32 亿美元，规模较 2018 年以 1.03 亿美元承诺额完成募集的上一只基金 Crescent CLO Equity Funding I 翻倍。该基金将投资于 Crescent CLO 的控制权头寸，并伺机投资其自有工具及第三方 CLO 的债务。

headline.en: Aperture litigation credit platform tops $600m, reaching $1bn capacity
headline.zh: Aperture诉讼信贷平台资产突破6亿美元，投资能力达10亿美元

summary.en: Aperture Investors has expanded its litigation-focused private credit platform to more than $600m in assets under management, the firm said, giving the Litigation Finance Private Credit platform approximately $1bn in total investment capacity. The strategy, led by portfolio manager Luke Darkow, makes structured loans primarily to law firms, collateralised by expected legal fee receivables from post-settlement, procedurally mature, near-settlement and short-duration cases. Aperture, founded in partnership with Generali Investments, manages around $6.72bn in assets.
summary.zh: Aperture Investors表示，其专注诉讼融资的私募信贷平台已扩大至超过6亿美元的资产管理规模，使Aperture的Litigation Finance Private Credit平台总投资能力达到约10亿美元。该策略由诉讼融资投资组合经理Luke Darkow领导，主要向律所提供结构性贷款，以和解后、程序成熟、接近和解及短周期的法律案件预期法律费用应收款作为抵押。Aperture与Generali Investments合作创立，管理约67.2亿美元资产。

headline.en: BDCs turn defensive as retail redemptions rise, Morningstar DBRS says
headline.zh: Morningstar DBRS称，随着零售赎回上升，BDC转向防御姿态

summary.en: Morningstar DBRS said business development companies have taken a more defensive approach amid a challenging operating environment, allowing repayments and portfolio exits to outpace new originations as redemptions from retail investors increased over the past two quarters. Average non-accruals rose to 3.4 per cent of investment portfolios in the second quarter of 2026 from 3.1 per cent in the fourth quarter of 2025, while software investments averaged about 15.7 per cent of portfolios at fair value. BlackRock TCP Capital Corp sold 48 per cent of its debt holdings to secondaries investor Pantheon.
summary.zh: Morningstar DBRS表示，面对充满挑战的经营环境，业务发展公司（BDC）已采取更为防御性的策略，在零售投资者赎回过去两个季度增加之际，允许还款和投资组合退出超过新增放款。2026年第二季度平均不良贷款占投资组合的比例升至3.4%，高于2025年第四季度的3.1%，软件投资按公允价值计平均约占投资组合的15.7%。BlackRock TCP Capital Corp将其48%的债务持仓出售给二级市场投资者Pantheon。

headline.en: Institutions weigh evergreen private credit structures as wealth redemptions mount
headline.zh: 随着财富端赎回增加，机构考虑常青私募信贷结构

summary.en: Withdrawals from non-traded business development companies over the first half of the year are prompting some institutional investors to reconsider committing capital alongside wealth clients, industry sources said. bfinance's Umang Rajbhandari said BDC redemptions have accelerated an existing trend toward institutional-grade evergreen vehicles with less emphasis on regular liquidity.
summary.zh: 行业消息人士称，今年上半年非交易型业务发展公司（BDC）的赎回潮正促使部分机构投资者重新考虑与财富客户共同出资。bfinance的Umang Rajbhandari表示，BDC赎回加速了机构投资者转向机构级常青工具、降低对定期流动性重视程度的既有趋势。

headline.en: Funding Circle posts 50pc revenue growth in H1, CEO Jacobs to step down
headline.zh: Funding Circle 上半年营收增长50%，CEO Jacobs 将卸任

summary.en: Funding Circle reported first-half 2026 revenue of £138.2m, up more than 50 per cent, and profit before tax of £24.1m. Credit extended rose 52 per cent to £1.7bn, with 18,000 UK SMEs backed. Chief executive Lisa Jacobs announced plans to step down by no later than September 2027.
summary.zh: Funding Circle 公布2026年上半年营收为1.382亿英镑，增长超过50%，税前利润为2410万英镑。信贷投放额增长52%至17亿英镑，共支持1.8万家英国中小企业。首席执行官 Lisa Jacobs 宣布计划最迟于2027年9月卸任。

headline.en: European direct lending sets half-year record despite Q2 slowdown
headline.zh: 欧洲直接贷款创半年纪录，尽管第二季度放缓

summary.en: European direct lending volumes fell 25 per cent year-on-year to €28.4bn across 296 deals in the second quarter of 2026, down from €38bn across 367 deals a year earlier, according to Debtwire research. Despite the slowdown, first-half 2026 volumes reached a record €63.16bn. Ares led the first half with 31 deals, followed by Arcmont with 23 and Apollo with 20.
summary.zh: 据Debtwire研究，2026年第二季度欧洲直接贷款规模同比下降25%至284亿欧元，共296笔交易，上年同期为380亿欧元、367笔交易。尽管有所放缓，2026年上半年贷款规模仍达到创纪录的631.6亿欧元。上半年Ares以31笔交易居首，Arcmont以23笔次之，Apollo以20笔位列第三。

headline.en: Downing adds £500m credit funding line and CRE lending head
headline.zh: Downing 增加 5 亿英镑信贷融资额度并任命商业地产贷款负责人

summary.en: Downing has launched a £500m institutional funding line to expand its private credit deployment capacity. It also appointed George Cotterell as partner and head of commercial real estate lending; he previously worked at Venn Partners and ESR Europe. Downing said it has committed £1.5bn to private credit transactions since 2010.
summary.zh: Downing 已推出一项 5 亿英镑的机构融资额度，以扩大其私人信贷投放能力。该公司还任命 George Cotterell 为合伙人兼商业地产贷款负责人；他此前曾在 Venn Partners 和 ESR Europe 任职。Downing 表示，自 2010 年以来已向私人信贷交易承诺 15 亿英镑。

headline.en: Franklin Templeton raises $1.5bn for inaugural collateralised fund obligation
headline.zh: 富兰克林邓普顿为首只抵押基金债券募集15亿美元

summary.en: Franklin Templeton has raised $1.5bn from global investors for its first collateralised fund obligation, Franklin Templeton Structured Solutions 2026. The vehicle will give investors exposure to two flagship private markets strategies spanning private equity secondaries and continuation vehicles, managed by Lexington Partners and Benefit Street Partners. Franklin Templeton Investment Solutions will serve as collateral manager, with Evercore as structuring advisor and placement agent and Simpson Thacher & Bartlett LLP as issuer counsel.
summary.zh: 富兰克林邓普顿已从全球投资者处为其首只抵押基金债券（CFO）募集15亿美元，该产品名为Franklin Templeton Structured Solutions 2026。该工具将让投资者获得两只旗舰私募市场策略的敞口，涵盖私募股权二级市场和接续基金，分别由Lexington Partners和Benefit Street Partners管理。Franklin Templeton Investment Solutions将担任该CFO的抵押品管理人，Evercore担任结构性顾问和配售代理，Simpson Thacher & Bartlett LLP担任发行人法律顾问。

headline.en: ICG closes European corporate fund at €12bn hard cap
headline.zh: ICG 欧洲企业基金以 120 亿欧元上限完成募集

summary.en: ICG raised €12bn at final close for its flagship European corporate strategy, ICG Europe Fund IX, a 50 per cent increase on its predecessor. The fund was oversubscribed and reached its €12bn hard cap, with about 90 new limited partners committing €6.7bn and existing investors committing a further €5.9bn. ICG said the fund is 22 per cent deployed across six investments, and ICG has $126bn in assets under management.
summary.zh: ICG 为其旗舰欧洲企业策略 ICG Europe Fund IX 完成最终募集，规模 120 亿欧元，较前一代基金增长 50%。该基金获超额认购并达到 120 亿欧元硬上限，约 90 位新有限合伙人承诺出资 67 亿欧元，既有投资者再承诺 59 亿欧元。ICG 表示该基金目前已在六项投资中部署 22%，ICG 资产管理规模为 1260 亿美元。

headline.en: Blue Owl Technology Finance Unit Closes $250 Million Credit Facility
headline.zh: Blue Owl Technology Finance 子公司完成2.5亿美元信贷安排

summary.en: Athena Funding IV LLC, a subsidiary of Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp., entered a credit agreement on August 14, 2026 with Natixis as administrative agent and Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company as collateral agent. The maximum principal amount available under the facility is $250 million, subject to a borrowing base and other tests. The facility has a reinvestment period of up to two years and matures on August 14, 2036.
summary.zh: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. 的子公司 Athena Funding IV LLC 于2026年8月14日签署信贷协议，Natixis 纽约分行担任行政代理，Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company 担任抵押品代理。该融资的最高可借本金为2.5亿美元，须满足借款基数测试等条件。融资再投资期最长两年，到期日为2036年8月14日。

headline.en: Pluto Finance flagship lending fund tops £500m, targets Europe
headline.zh: Pluto Finance旗舰贷款基金募资突破5亿英镑，进军欧洲

summary.en: Pluto Finance said commitments to its flagship Lending Vehicle VIII have surpassed £500m, with the evergreen UK development and property lending fund exceeding £1bn in total financing. The firm is expanding lending into continental Europe, targeting 20 per cent of financing from markets including Germany, the Netherlands, Ireland, Spain and Portugal, and has introduced multi-site revolving credit facilities for UK housebuilders.
summary.zh: Pluto Finance表示，其旗舰基金Lending Vehicle VIII的承诺出资已超过5亿英镑，这只专注于英国的常青型开发及物业贷款基金累计融资额已突破10亿英镑。该公司正将贷款业务拓展至欧洲大陆，目标是使包括德国、荷兰、爱尔兰、西班牙和葡萄牙在内的市场贡献20%的融资额，并已为英国房屋建筑商推出多站点循环信贷额度。

headline.en: Ninety One closes Africa Credit Opportunities Fund 3 at $404m
headline.zh: Ninety One 以 4.04 亿美元完成 Africa Credit Opportunities Fund 3 募集

summary.en: Ninety One announced the final close of its Africa Credit Opportunities Fund 3 with commitments totalling $404m. The fund drew commitments from development finance institutions, pension funds and family offices across Africa, Europe, the UK, the US and Canada, and invests mainly in senior secured private credit in Africa and other emerging markets. Since inception the emerging market senior credit strategy has raised $815m across three funds, the article says.
summary.zh: Ninety One 宣布其 Africa Credit Opportunities Fund 3 完成最终募集，承诺总额达 4.04 亿美元。该基金获得了来自非洲、欧洲、英国、美国和加拿大的开发性金融机构、养老基金和家族办公室的承诺，主要投资于非洲及其他新兴市场的优先担保私募信贷。文章称，自成立以来，其新兴市场优先信贷策略在三只基金中累计募集了 8.15 亿美元。

headline.en: MUFG in talks with BlackRock and Morgan Stanley on Japanese private credit platform
headline.zh: MUFG 与 BlackRock 和 Morgan Stanley 就日本私人信贷平台进行洽谈

summary.en: MUFG is exploring separate collaborations with BlackRock and Morgan Stanley Investment Management to develop an open platform for institutional investment in Japanese private credit. The discussions cover evaluation, sourcing and investment in private credit opportunities and aim to connect domestic and global capital with Japanese companies. BlackRock would contribute private credit expertise through its HPS platform, while MSIM has provided debt solutions globally for more than 15 years.
summary.zh: MUFG 正在探讨分别与 BlackRock 和 Morgan Stanley Investment Management 合作，打造面向机构投资者的日本私人信贷开放平台。洽谈内容涵盖私人信贷机会的评估、项目获取与投资，目标是连接日本企业与境内外资本。BlackRock 将通过其 HPS 平台提供全球私人信贷经验，而 MSIM 在全球提供债务解决方案已有 15 年以上。

headline.en: CMBS issuance on pace for nearly $140 billion in 2026, Trepp says
headline.zh: Trepp称2026年CMBS发行量有望接近1400亿美元

summary.en: The CMBS market is on pace to reach nearly $140 billion of issuance in 2026, above Trepp's initial $130 billion forecast, with single-asset, single-borrower deals driving the reassessment. More than $90 billion of CMBS volume was scheduled to close through early September, according to Trepp's Stephen Buschbom and Andy Boettcher. The market issued $126.6 billion in 2025 and $108 billion in 2024.
summary.zh: CMBS市场2026年发行量有望达到近1400亿美元，高于Trepp最初1300亿美元的预测，其中单一资产单一借款人（SASB）交易推动了这一重新评估。Trepp的Stephen Buschbom和Andy Boettcher表示，截至9月初已有超过900亿美元的CMBS交易计划完成。该市场2025年发行量为1266亿美元，2024年为1080亿美元。

headline.en: Pretium adds Cascade Financial Services to residential credit platform
headline.zh: Pretium将Cascade Financial Services纳入住宅信贷平台

summary.en: Pretium announced that Cascade Financial Services, an independent lender serving manufactured home buyers, is joining its residential credit platform. Pretium's residential credit platform manages $29 billion, and the firm manages more than $70 billion in assets. No transaction value was disclosed; Scotiabank advised Pretium.
summary.zh: Pretium宣布，服务于预制房屋购房者的独立贷款机构Cascade Financial Services将加入其住宅信贷平台。Pretium的住宅信贷平台管理290亿美元资产，公司整体管理资产超过700亿美元。

headline.en: Managers Build 401(k) Teams a Year After Alternatives Order
headline.zh: 另类资产行政令一年后 管理机构组建401(k)团队

summary.en: A year after President Donald Trump signed an executive order directing federal agencies to review regulations so private credit and other alternatives could more easily enter 401(k) retirement accounts, private credit managers have been hiring defined contribution experts, launching new products and striking partnerships. In March the Department of Labor proposed a rule establishing process-based "safe harbors" for plan fiduciaries selecting designated investment alternatives, aimed at reducing litigation exposure. Litigation risk and lingering reservations remain barriers to the near $14tn US 401(k) market.
summary.zh: 美国总统Donald Trump签署行政令、指示联邦机构审查法规以便私人信贷及其他另类资产更易进入401(k)退休账户一年后，私人信贷管理机构一直在招聘定义缴款（DC）专家、推出新产品并达成合作。3月，美国劳工部（DOL）提出一项规则，为计划受托人在选择401(k)指定投资替代品时建立基于流程的“安全港”，旨在降低诉讼风险。诉讼风险和挥之不去的顾虑仍是进入近14万亿美元美国401(k)市场的障碍。

headline.en: Pallas Capital secures £200m senior credit line from European debt fund
headline.zh: Pallas Capital从欧洲债务基金获得2亿英镑高级信贷额度

summary.en: UK bridging lender Pallas Capital has secured a £200m senior funding line from a European debt fund. The facility will support its UK lending across residential, mixed-use and commercial bridging, refurbishment and development finance. Pallas Capital began UK operations in January 2026 and is part of Pallas Group, which manages a loan book of approximately £2.5bn.
summary.zh: 英国过桥贷款机构Pallas Capital已从一家欧洲债务基金获得2亿英镑高级融资额度。该额度将支持其在英国的贷款业务，涵盖住宅、混合用途及商业过桥贷款、翻新和开发融资。Pallas Capital于2026年1月开始在英国运营，隶属于Pallas Group，后者管理着约25亿英镑的贷款组合。

headline.en: Partners Group closes $1bn private credit mandate with Asia investor
headline.zh: Partners Group与亚洲投资者完成10亿美元私募信贷委托

summary.en: Partners Group has closed a $1bn private credit mandate with a major institutional investor in Asia. The open-ended evergreen structure includes a discretionary tranche managed by the firm and co-investment capital, and will invest in senior and junior direct lending opportunities in Asia Pacific. Partners Group manages over $40bn in private credit assets globally.
summary.zh: Partners Group与一家亚洲大型机构投资者完成了一笔10亿美元的私募信贷委托。该开放式永续结构包含由该公司管理的一个全权委托部分以及共同投资资本，将投资于亚太地区的优先和次级直接贷款机会。Partners Group全球管理超过400亿美元私募信贷资产。

headline.en: Bridgepoint moves €1.2bn of loans into Pantheon-led continuation vehicle
headline.zh: Bridgepoint将12亿欧元贷款转入Pantheon牵头的延续基金

summary.en: Bridgepoint Credit has transferred €1.2bn of loans from its 2017-vintage Bridgepoint Direct Lending II fund into a continuation vehicle led by secondaries investor Pantheon. The transaction, which was oversubscribed, gives BDL II investors the option to realise their investment or retain exposure, and Bridgepoint will remain manager of the portfolio until realisation. The portfolio is weighted towards senior secured credits across healthcare, services and technology, with UK, DACH, Nordics, Benelux and French middle-market borrowers.
summary.zh: Bridgepoint Credit已将其2017年募集的Bridgepoint Direct Lending II基金中的12亿欧元贷款转入由二级市场投资者Pantheon牵头的延续基金。该交易获得超额认购，为BDL II投资者提供变现投资或保留敞口的选择，Bridgepoint将继续担任该投资组合的管理人直至实现退出。该组合偏重医疗、服务和技术领域的高级担保信贷，借款方来自英国、DACH地区、北欧、比荷卢和法国中型市场。

headline.en: Hercules Adviser closes two private credit vehicles with $2.3bn
headline.zh: Hercules Adviser 关闭两只私募信贷工具，募资23亿美元

summary.en: Hercules Adviser, the registered investment adviser to Hercules Capital, closed two institutional private credit vehicles: the perpetual open-end Hercules Evergreen Fund and the closed-end Hercules Growth Lending IV. A rated securitisation also closed, with all three vehicles receiving commitments from global institutional investors. Hercules Capital and Hercules Adviser manage approximately $6.1bn in assets.
summary.zh: Hercules Capital 的注册投资顾问 Hercules Adviser 关闭了两只机构私募信贷工具：永续开放式基金 Hercules Evergreen Fund 和封闭式平台 Hercules Growth Lending IV。同时完成一项有评级的证券化，三只工具均获得全球机构投资者的承诺出资。Hercules Capital 与 Hercules Adviser 合计管理约61亿美元资产。

headline.en: CRED iQ Tracks 82 Modified CMBS and CRE CLO Loans Worth $2.36 Billion
headline.zh: CRED iQ追踪82笔修改后的CMBS和CRE CLO贷款，价值23.6亿美元

summary.en: CRED iQ tracked 82 modified CMBS and CRE CLO loans with a combined $2.36 billion in outstanding balance from May through July 2026. Maturity extensions remained the largest category at 21 loans and $802.5 million, followed by forbearances at 15 loans and $514 million and combination modifications at 10 loans and $345.6 million. Multifamily led by property type with 35 loans totaling $1.14 billion, or 48.4 percent of modified balance.
summary.zh: CRED iQ追踪到2026年5月至7月期间82笔修改后的CMBS和CRE CLO贷款，未偿余额合计23.6亿美元。到期日延长仍是最大类别，为21笔贷款、8.025亿美元；其次是宽限，为15笔贷款、5.14亿美元；组合修改为10笔贷款、3.456亿美元。按物业类型，多户住宅以35笔贷款、11.4亿美元领先，占修改余额的48.4%。

headline.en: Vornado, Related's $396 Million 85 10th Avenue CMBS Loan Sent to Special Servicing
headline.zh: Vornado与Related旗下8500万美元85 10th Avenue CMBS贷款被移交特殊服务商

summary.en: A $396 million CMBS loan secured by 85 10th Avenue, a 633,000-square-foot Manhattan office property owned jointly by Vornado Realty Trust and the Related Companies, has been sent to special servicing over imminent maturity default, per a Morningstar Credit alert. The loan matures in December 2026, and the property's cash flow fell 28 percent below underwriting in 2025, with Google as the largest tenant at 47 percent of space.
summary.zh: 据Morningstar Credit警报，由Vornado Realty Trust与Related Companies共同持有、位于曼哈顿的63.3万平方英尺写字楼85 10th Avenue所担保的3.96亿美元CMBS贷款，因即将到期违约被移交特殊服务商。该贷款将于2026年12月到期，该物业2025年现金流较承销预期下降28%，最大租户Google占其面积的47%。

headline.en: Moody's: Insurers to raise private credit allocations
headline.zh: 穆迪：保险公司将提高私募信贷配置

summary.en: Moody's found that 42 per cent of US insurers and 36 per cent of UK and European insurers plan to increase private credit exposure. Private credit was an estimated 35 per cent of US life insurers' investments at end-2025, versus around 20 per cent in the UK and 11 per cent in Europe. Insurers are broadening into asset-based finance, fund finance, direct lending and private structured credit.
summary.zh: 穆迪发现，42%的美国保险公司以及36%的英国和欧洲保险公司计划增加私募信贷敞口。截至2025年底，私募信贷估计占美国寿险公司投资的35%，英国约为20%，欧洲为11%。保险公司正将配置扩展至资产支持融资、基金融资、直接贷款和私人结构化信贷等领域。

headline.en: CVC Credit says private credit appetite robust in H1 2026 as technology underwriting turns cautious
headline.zh: CVC Credit称2026年上半年私人信贷需求强劲，科技类承销转趋谨慎

summary.en: CVC Credit said private credit appetite remained "robust" in the first half of 2026, with more than $208bn raised in the period. Senior direct lending accounted for 60 per cent of capital raised, up from 42 per cent in 2025, while technology's share of European deal activity fell to 22 per cent from 29 per cent in 2025.
summary.zh: CVC Credit表示，2026年上半年私人信贷需求保持“强劲”，期内募资超过2080亿美元。优先直接贷款占募资额的60%，高于2025年的42%；与此同时，科技在欧洲交易活动中的占比从2025年的29%降至22%。

headline.en: ONEOK to Buy Brazos Midstream Permian Assets for $4.425 Billion, Funded by $9 Billion Apollo Investment
headline.zh: ONEOK将以44.25亿美元收购Brazos Midstream二叠纪资产，由Apollo 90亿美元投资提供资金

summary.en: ONEOK has agreed to acquire Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin natural gas gathering and processing assets for $4.425 billion in cash. The deal is funded by a $9 billion nonvoting minority equity investment from funds and affiliates managed by Apollo, with $5 billion used to reduce ONEOK's existing debt. Apollo said the investment carries an IRR capped at 7.0% for the first nine years.
summary.zh: ONEOK已达成协议，以44.25亿美元现金收购Brazos Midstream在二叠纪Midland盆地的天然气集输与处理资产。该交易由Apollo管理基金及关联方提供的90亿美元无投票权少数股权投�资提供资金，其中50亿美元用于削减ONEOK现有债务。Apollo表示该投资前九年的内部收益率上限为7.0%。

headline.en: Jefferies Credit Partners reaches $4bn European lending capacity at first close
headline.zh: Jefferies Credit Partners 首次关账时欧洲贷款能力达 40 亿美元

summary.en: Jefferies Credit Partners has reached $4bn of lending capacity for its European institutional direct lending strategy at first close. The fund was anchored by Allianz Global Investors, with investments from the South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission and other institutional investors, and was seeded through the acquisition of a portfolio of recently originated European private credit investments. Jefferies said it anticipates close to $4bn of lending capacity for the European strategy in the near term, including the fund, two partnership accounts expected to close later in 2026 and Jefferies' balance sheet resources.
summary.zh: Jefferies Credit Partners 的欧洲机构直接贷款策略在首次关账时达到 40 亿美元贷款能力。该基金由 Allianz Global Investors 领投，South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission 及其他机构投资者参与投资，并通过收购一批近期发起的欧洲私募信贷投资组合完成种子投资。Jefferies 表示，预计近期该欧洲策略的贷款能力将接近 40 亿美元，包括该基金、预计于 2026 年晚些时候完成的两只合作账户以及 Jefferies 的自有资产负债表资源。

headline.en: Bally's Secures $560M Loan from WhiteHawk for Bronx Casino
headline.zh: Bally's 从 WhiteHawk 获得 5.6 亿美元贷款用于布朗克斯赌场开发

summary.en: Bally's has secured a $560 million debt package from WhiteHawk Capital Partners to fund its casino development in the Bronx. The financing consists of a $400 million frontloaded loan and $160 million in delayed-draw term debt, with the deal slated to close in the third quarter. The loans will fund pre-construction and other expenditures for the planned 3 million-square-foot casino development at Bally's Golf Links at Ferry Point.
summary.zh: Bally's 已从 WhiteHawk Capital Partners 获得 5.6 亿美元债务融资，用于资助其在布朗克斯的赌场开发项目。该融资包括 4 亿美元的前置贷款和 1.6 亿美元的延迟提取定期债务，交易预计在第三季度完成。这些贷款将为 Bally's Golf Links at Ferry Point 计划中的 300 万平方英尺赌场开发项目的前期建设及其他支出提供资金。

headline.en: Blue Owl Managed Funds Lead $2.4 Billion AI Factory Financing for IREN
headline.zh: Blue Owl管理的基金牵头为IREN提供24亿美元AI工厂融资

summary.en: Blue Owl announced that funds it manages led a $2.4 billion compute equipment financing for IREN Limited, an AI cloud platform. The financing comprises a $1.2 billion senior secured term loan and $1.2 billion of senior secured notes, funding IREN's purchase of air-cooled NVIDIA accelerated computing infrastructure, including Blackwell Ultra GPUs, for its Mackenzie data center campus in British Columbia, Canada.
summary.zh: Blue Owl宣布，其管理的基金牵头为AI云平台IREN Limited提供24亿美元算力设备融资。该融资包括12亿美元优先级担保定期贷款和12亿美元优先级担保票据，用于资助IREN采购风冷NVIDIA加速计算基础设施（包括Blackwell Ultra GPU），用于其在加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省的Mackenzie数据中心园区。

headline.en: AI infrastructure outside US draws private capital in H1 2026, GPCA data shows
headline.zh: GPCA数据显示，2026年上半年美国以外的AI基础设施吸引私人资本

summary.en: Private capital investment in AI infrastructure outside the US reached $14.8bn in the first half of 2026, compared with $2.3bn in the whole of 2025, while digital infrastructure investment reached $9.6bn versus $8.7bn in 2025, according to Global Private Capital Association data. DayOne Data Centers closed a $4.5bn Series C equity round in June 2026 led by Coatue and Hillhouse Investment alongside the Indonesia Investment Authority, and Liquid Intelligent Technologies raised a $660m debt round including a $150m loan anchored by Ninety One-managed private credit funds.
summary.zh: 根据Global Private Capital Association的数据，2026年上半年美国以外的AI基础设施私人资本投资达到148亿美元，而2025年全年为23亿美元；数字基础设施投资达96亿美元，2025年为87亿美元。DayOne Data Centers于2026年6月完成45亿美元C轮股权融资，由Coatue和Hillhouse Investment领投，Indonesia Investment Authority参与；Liquid Intelligent Technologies完成6.6亿美元债务融资，其中包括由Ninety One管理的私人信贷基金作为锚定投资者的1.5亿美元贷款。

headline.en: Hoya Capital Report Finds 83% of Over 200 U.S. REITs Raised Full-Year FFO Guidance
headline.zh: Hoya Capital 报告发现 200 多家美国 REIT 中有 83% 上调全年 FFO 指引

summary.en: A Hoya Capital report covering over 200 U.S. REITs and homebuilders found that 83 percent of publicly traded REITs raised full-year FFO guidance after second-quarter 2026 earnings, while 4 percent lowered their outlooks. National office leasing rose 16 percent year-over-year to 62.4 million square feet. Hoya Capital said high interest rates and weak investor confidence continue to weigh on the sector, with the Equity REIT Index down 0.7 percent from July 12 through Aug. 11 while the S&P 500 gained nearly 4 percent.
summary.zh: Hoya Capital 一份覆盖 200 多家美国 REIT 和住宅建筑商的报告发现，在 2026 年第二季度财报后，83% 的上市 REIT 上调了全年 FFO 指引，4% 下调了展望。全美办公楼租赁面积同比增长 16%，达到 6,240 万平方英尺。Hoya Capital 表示，高利率和投资者信心不足继续拖累该板块，7 月 12 日至 8 月 11 日期间权益 REIT 指数下跌 0.7%，而标普 500 指数上涨近 4%。

headline.en: Granite Asia raises $500m for Pan-Asia private credit strategy
headline.zh: Granite Asia 为泛亚私募信贷策略募集 5 亿美元

summary.en: Granite Asia has raised $500m for its Pan-Asia private credit strategy, Libra Hybrid, with commitments from DBS Private Bank, a leading insurer and other institutional investors. The strategy invests in Asian mid-market companies and has completed eight transactions since launching in 2025. Anchor investors include Temasek via Aranda Principal Strategies, Khazanah Nasional Berhad and the Indonesia Investment Authority.
summary.zh: Granite Asia 为其泛亚私募信贷策略 Libra Hybrid 募集了 5 亿美元，出资方包括 DBS Private Bank、一家领先保险公司及其他机构投资者。该策略投资于亚洲中型市场企业，自 2025 年启动以来已完成八笔交易。锚定投资者包括通过其私募信贷平台 Aranda Principal Strategies 出资的 Temasek、Khazanah Nasional Berhad 以及 Indonesia Investment Authority。

headline.en: Affinius Capital, Axonic Capital Lend $48M for Suburban Boston Apartments
headline.zh: Affinius Capital与Axonic Capital为波士顿郊区公寓提供4800万美元贷款

summary.en: Affinius Capital and Axonic Capital provided $48 million in construction financing to Dinosaur Capital Partners for a 130-unit multifamily project in Lexington, Massachusetts. The five-story complex will include 110 market-rate and 20 affordable units, and marks the lenders' sixth transaction since their partnership began.
summary.zh: Affinius Capital和Axonic Capital向Dinosaur Capital Partners提供4800万美元建设融资，用于在马萨诸塞州列克星敦开发130套多户住宅项目。该五层综合体将包含110套市场价公寓和20套经济适用房，这是两家贷款机构自合作以来的第六笔交易。

headline.en: Claret raises €575m for fourth European growth debt fund
headline.zh: Claret 为第四只欧洲成长债务基金募集 5.75 亿欧元

summary.en: Claret Capital Partners has raised €575m for its fourth European growth debt fund at final close, surpassing its €500m target. The fund has already invested 32 per cent across 27 venture and growth companies in technology, life sciences and impact sectors. The close brings Claret's total capital raised since inception to €1.3bn.
summary.zh: Claret Capital Partners 第四只欧洲成长债务基金完成最终募集，规模 5.75 亿欧元，超过其 5 亿欧元的目标。该基金已投出 32%，覆盖科技、生命科学和影响力领域的 27 家创业与成长型企业。此次募集使 Claret 自成立以来的累计募资额达到 13 亿欧元。

headline.en: Sculptor resets and upsizes US CLO XXXIII by $45m
headline.zh: Sculptor 重置并将美国 CLO 增额 4500 万美元

summary.en: Sculptor Capital Management has reset and upsized its US CLO, Sculptor CLO XXXIII, by $45m from its original closing. The reset establishes a new five-year reinvestment period and a two-year non-call period, with JP Morgan arranging the transaction. Sculptor's global ICS platform manages a suite of CLOs and collateralised bond obligations totalling approximately $12.5bn.
summary.zh: Sculptor Capital Management 已重置并将其美国 CLO——Sculptor CLO XXXIII——在原有关闭规模基础上增额 4500 万美元。此次重置设立了新的五年再投资期和两年不可赎回期，交易由 JP Morgan 安排。Sculptor 的全球 ICS 平台管理着约 125 亿美元的 CLO 和担保债券凭证组合。

headline.en: Crestline closes second European capital solutions fund at $625m
headline.zh: Crestline 第二只欧洲基金以 6.25 亿美元完成募集

summary.en: Crestline Management has raised $625m in the final close of its second European capital solutions fund, nearly 75 per cent more than its inaugural fund. The fund targets senior debt to structured equity for asset-backed and lower-middle-market businesses across North and Western Europe and has committed about 35 percent of its capital since launching in 2025.
summary.zh: Crestline Management 的第二只欧洲资本解决方案基金完成最终募集，募资 6.25 亿美元，较其首只基金高出近 75%。该基金面向北欧和西欧的资产支持型及中低端市场企业，提供从优先债到结构化股权等多种资本解决方案，自 2025 年成立以来已承诺投资约 35% 的资金。

headline.en: Australia's ASIC temporarily bans three private credit products from Melbourne Securities
headline.zh: 澳大利亚监管机构暂时禁止Melbourne Securities的三只私人信贷产品

summary.en: The Australian Securities and Investments Commission issued stop orders on three private credit products offered under the Remara Cash Management Fund by Melbourne Securities Corporation, citing deficiencies in their target market determinations. The 21-day orders prevent MSC from dealing in interests, giving a product disclosure statement, or providing general financial product advice to retail clients recommending the fund's products. ASIC said the action is part of its work on private credit risks and that the sector should prepare for enforcement action, following the insolvency of Sydney-based housing developer Bathla Group.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚证券和投资委员会对Melbourne Securities Corporation（MSC）在Remara Cash Management Fund下提供的三只私人信贷产品发布停止令，称其目标市场认定存在缺陷。为期21天的命令禁止MSC就基金产品进行权益交易、提供产品披露声明，或向零售客户提供推荐投资的一般性金融产品建议。ASIC表示此举是其应对私人信贷风险工作的一部分，并表示该行业应准备接受执法行动；此前悉尼住房开发商Bathla Group破产。

headline.en: S&P: Private Credit Defaults Stay Resilient Despite AI Disruption Fears
headline.zh: 标普：尽管存在AI颠覆担忧，私人信贷违约仍保持韧性

summary.en: S&P Global Ratings analysts said there has been no commensurate rise in defaults despite concerns over private credit's exposure to software and macroeconomic volatility, with the US default rate for credit estimates falling to 3.9 per cent at the end of June 2026 from 5.3 per cent at the start of the year. S&P's Sylvain Broyer said inflation will remain a challenge amid successive supply-side shocks and that he expects the ECB and the Federal Reserve to hike rates later this year, while long-term interest rates are roughly at peak absent a further major shock.
summary.zh: 标普全球评级分析师表示，尽管市场担忧私人信贷对软件行业的敞口及宏观经济波动，违约并未相应上升；信用评估的美国违约率在2026年6月底降至3.9%，而年初为5.3%。标普的Sylvain Broyer表示，在一系列供给侧冲击下通胀仍将是挑战，他预计欧洲央行和美联储将在今年晚些时候加息，而若没有进一步的重大冲击，长期利率大致已见顶。

headline.en: Velocity to manage Toorak's $3bn loan portfolio and acquire its platform
headline.zh: Velocity 将管理 Toorak 的 30 亿美元贷款组合并收购其平台

summary.en: Velocity Financial has agreed to manage a $3bn business-purpose loan portfolio from Toorak Capital and acquire Toorak's operating platform. Toorak, majority owned by funds advised by KKR affiliates, has funded more than $20bn cumulatively across almost 43,000 loans and will retain its brands, management team and Tampa headquarters as a subsidiary of Velocity Commercial Capital. The total value of the platform and portfolio transactions is estimated at approximately $3.2bn.
summary.zh: Velocity Financial 已达成协议，将管理 Toorak Capital 的 30 亿美元商业用途贷款组合，并收购 Toorak 的运营平台。Toorak 由 KKR 关联公司顾问的基金持有多数股权，自成立以来累计放款超过 200 亿美元、涉及近 4.3 万笔贷款；交易完成后 Toorak 将保留其品牌、管理团队和坦帕总部，并成为 Velocity Commercial Capital 的子公司。据 Velocity 称，平台与组合交易的总价值估计约为 32 亿美元。

headline.en: Bathla Group collapses owing about A$3.4bn to private lenders
headline.zh: 澳大利亚开发商Bathla Group倒闭，欠私人贷款机构约34亿澳元

summary.en: Australian property developer Bathla Group fell into administration on 25 August owing around A$3.4bn, almost all to non-bank lenders, with about 40 private credit funds exposed. Administrators from Teneo told creditors on 4 September that secured lenders are owed A$3.1bn, alongside A$145m to the Australian Taxation Office and other claims. CVS Lane Capital Partners suspended redemptions in two funds, Centuria Bass paused redemptions and applications on 14 August, and MA Financial capped monthly redemptions at 1 per cent from 25 August despite saying it has no Bathla exposure.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚房地产开发商Bathla Group于8月25日进入破产管理程序，欠款约34亿澳元，几乎全部来自非银行放贷机构，约40只私人信贷基金存在敞口。Teneo的管理人于9月4日向债权人会议表示，有担保贷款人被欠31亿澳元，另有1.45亿澳元欠澳大利亚税务局及其他债权。CVS Lane Capital Partners暂停了两只基金的赎回，Centuria Bass于8月14日暂停赎回和申购，MA Financial自8月25日起将旗舰房地产信贷基金的月度赎回上限设为1%，尽管其表示对Bathla没有敞口。

headline.en: KBRA reports rising BDC non-accruals in Q2 2026
headline.zh: KBRA 报告称 2026 年第二季度 BDC 不良贷款增加

summary.en: KBRA's quarterly BDC analysis found non-accrual investments at non-perpetual-life BDCs rose to a median 2.75% of total investments at cost in Q2 2026, up from 1.81% in Q1. Deterioration remains concentrated among a limited number of borrowers and managers, and KBRA characterized the data as credit normalisation rather than broad-based deterioration. Income pressure persists as rates are lower than in 2025, loan spreads are tighter and M&A and refinancing activity has slowed.
summary.zh: KBRA 对 BDC 的季度分析发现，2026 年第二季度非永久存续期 BDC 的不良投资中位数升至总投资的 2.75%（按成本计），高于第一季度的 1.81%。KBRA 表示，恶化仍集中在少数借款人和管理人，数据更符合信贷环境正常化而非广泛的信贷恶化。由于利率低于 2025 年、贷款利差收窄且并购和再融资活动放缓，BDC 收入持续承压。

headline.en: Nuveen raises over $1bn for fourth climate-focused property lending fund
headline.zh: Nuveen 为第四只气候主题地产贷款基金募资逾 10 亿美元

summary.en: Nuveen Green Capital announced the first close of its Nuveen CPACE Lending Fund IV, raising over $1bn. Total commitments across the C-PACE fund series reach $3bn since inception in 2023, and Nuveen Green Capital now has $6bn in assets under management. The series covers 39 US states plus the District of Columbia, with commitments including those from North American insurers.
summary.zh: Nuveen Green Capital 宣布其 Nuveen CPACE Lending Fund IV 完成首次关账，募资超过 10 亿美元。该 C-PACE 基金系列自 2023 年成立以来的总承诺额达到 30 亿美元，Nuveen Green Capital 目前管理资产规模为 60 亿美元。该系列覆盖美国 39 个州及哥伦比亚特区，承诺方包括北美保险公司。

headline.en: Goldman to acquire LCN Capital Partners for about $260m
headline.zh: 高盛将以约2.6亿美元收购LCN Capital Partners

summary.en: Goldman Sachs has agreed to acquire real estate investment manager LCN Capital Partners for approximately $260m, with another $150m contingent on long-dated performance targets and service commitments. Roughly 80 per cent of the total will be paid in equity, and the deal is expected to close by the end of 2026 subject to regulatory approval. LCN, founded in 2011, focuses on sale-leaseback, build-to-suit and triple net lease sectors and has $3bn in assets under supervision.
summary.zh: 高盛已同意以约2.6亿美元收购房地产投资管理公司LCN Capital Partners，另有1.5亿美元取决于长期业绩目标和服务承诺的达成。交易总额约80%将以股权支付，预计在2026年底前完成，尚待监管批准。LCN成立于2011年，专注于售后回租、定制建造和净租赁领域，管理资产规模为30亿美元。

headline.en: Blue Owl Technology Income Corp. files 8-K on Class I share sale and declared distributions
headline.zh: Blue Owl Technology Income Corp. 就 Class I 股份出售及已宣派分派提交 8-K

summary.en: Blue Owl Technology Income Corp. sold 89,128 unregistered Class I common shares to feeder vehicles for about $869,000 as of September 1, 2026. The company also reported monthly distributions declared on August 4, 2026, payable on or before October 30, 2026 and November 30, 2026, with gross distributions of $0.074775 per share across Class S, Class D and Class I. Total shares issued across its offering and private offering stood at 396,521,957 for $4,067,535,551 as of the filing.
summary.zh: Blue Owl Technology Income Corp. 向 feeder vehicles 出售了 89,128 股未注册 Class I 普通股，对价约为 869,000 美元，截至 2026 年 9 月 1 日。公司还报告了 2026 年 8 月 4 日宣派的月度分派，支付日期不晚于 2026 年 10 月 30 日和 2026 年 11 月 30 日，Class S、Class D 和 Class I 的毛分派均为每股 0.074775 美元。截至申报日，其发行及私募发行累计已发行股份 396,521,957 股，总对价 4,067,535,551 美元。

headline.en: Tax-Exempt CMBS Market Grows on Affordable Housing Demand
headline.zh: 免税商业抵押贷款支持证券市场因保障房需求而增长

summary.en: The tax-exempt commercial mortgage-backed securities market is growing as a financing tool for affordable housing, helped by new federal rules and greater attention from ratings agencies and top-tier banks. Citigroup and Freddie Mac rolled out programs in the late 2010s, and Freddie Mac expanded outreach in late 2024 through a new registration system. In July, Systima Capital Management closed a $153 million tax-exempt affordable housing bond deal through the Public Finance Authority, more than eight times oversubscribed with over $1.2 billion in orders from 19 institutional investors.
summary.zh: 随着保障性住房融资需求上升，免税商业抵押贷款支持证券（CMBS）市场正作为一种融资工具发展壮大，新联邦规则以及评级机构和顶级银行更多的关注推动了这一趋势。花旗集团和房地美在2010年代末推出了相关计划，房地美并于2024年底通过新的登记系统扩大了覆盖范围。7月，Systima Capital Management通过总部位于威斯康星州的通道发行人Public Finance Authority完成了一笔1.53亿美元的免税保障房债券交易，超额认购逾八倍，来自19家机构投资者的订单超过12亿美元。

headline.en: Domestic funds lead India private credit as H1 deal value slumps
headline.zh: 上半年交易额下滑之际，本土基金主导印度私募信贷

summary.en: Domestic funds accounted for 74 per cent of India's private credit deal value and around 79 per cent of deal volume in the first half of 2026, according to an EY report. Global funds' share of deal value fell from 68 per cent to 26 per cent year over year. The period recorded 102 private credit deals worth more than $10m each, with an aggregate value of $3.5bn, down from $9bn in the first half of 2025. Real estate credit took 35 per cent of total deal value.
summary.zh: 安永报告显示，2026年上半年印度私募信贷交易额中，本土基金占74%，交易数量约占79%。全球基金的交易额占比同比从68%降至26%。期内印度录得102笔金额超过1000万美元的私募信贷交易，合计价值35亿美元，低于2025年上半年的90亿美元。房地产信贷占交易总额的35%。

headline.en: CIFC launches direct lending strategy on iCapital Marketplace
headline.zh: CIFC 在 iCapital Marketplace 上线直接贷款策略

summary.en: CIFC Asset Management has launched its direct lending strategy on iCapital Marketplace. The strategy lends to US lower middle market companies with $50m to $500m in revenue, focusing on senior secured, floating-rate loans with financial covenants and cash-pay interest, and the portfolio has included no covenant-lite loans to date.
summary.zh: CIFC Asset Management 已在 iCapital Marketplace 上线其直接贷款策略。该策略向收入在 5000 万至 5 亿美元的美国低中端市场公司放贷，专注于有财务契约和现金付息的高级担保浮动利率贷款，迄今为止其直接贷款组合未包含任何契约宽松（covenant-lite）贷款。

headline.en: GTIS rebrands as Brightshore Capital, launches real estate debt platform
headline.zh: GTIS 更名为 Brightshore Capital 并推出房地产债务平台

summary.en: GTIS Partners has rebranded as Brightshore Capital following its transition to 100 per cent ownership by the firm's partners. The manager also launched Brightshore Credit, focused on originating and investing in high-yield real estate debt including stretch senior and mezzanine financings, preferred equity and B-notes, anchored with $250m. Brightshore manages $5.6bn in assets.
summary.zh: GTIS Partners 在该公司合伙人实现100%持股后更名为 Brightshore Capital。该管理公司还推出了 Brightshore Credit，专注于发起和投资高收益房地产债务，包括拉伸高级和夹层融资、优先股股权和B-note，初始锚定资金为2.5亿美元。Brightshore 管理资产规模为56亿美元。

headline.en: Victory Capital to acquire First Eagle for $7bn, adding $41bn CLO and alt credit platform
headline.zh: Victory Capital 将以 70 亿美元收购 First Eagle，纳入 410 亿美元 CLO 及另类信贷平台

summary.en: Victory Capital has agreed to acquire 100 per cent of First Eagle Investments from Genstar Capital and First Eagle employees for $7bn, comprising $4.4bn in cash and $2bn in newly issued Victory Capital equity. First Eagle manages $222bn in assets, including a $41bn CLO and alternative credit business that will join Victory's broader alternatives offering once the deal completes. Victory said the combined firm would have $571bn in assets.
summary.zh: Victory Capital 已达成协议，以 70 亿美元从 Genstar Capital 和 First Eagle 员工手中收购 First Eagle Investments 的 100% 股权，对价包括 44 亿美元现金和 20 亿美元新发行的 Victory Capital 股票。First Eagle 管理 2220 亿美元资产，其中包括 410 亿美元的 CLO 及另类信贷业务，该业务将在交易完成后并入 Victory 更广泛的另类投资业务。Victory 表示合并后公司资产规模将达 5710 亿美元。

headline.en: Principal opens US 401(k) plans to private markets
headline.zh: Principal向私募市场开放美国401(k)计划

summary.en: Principal Financial Group has expanded its US retirement plan business to include private markets, planning collective investment trusts (CITs) that combine public and private strategies. The firm said it will collaborate with asset managers including Blackstone, Ares, KKR and Partners Group, with private market managers in the expanded Featured Partner Programme including Apollo, Blue Owl, Carlyle, Neuberger and others. The move follows an executive order by President Donald Trump a year earlier opening 401(k) accounts to alternative investments.
summary.zh: Principal Financial Group已将其美国退休计划业务扩展至私募市场，计划推出结合公开与私募策略的集体投资信托（CIT）。该公司表示将与Blackstone、Ares、KKR和Partners Group等资产管理公司合作，参与扩展后Featured Partner Programme的私募市场管理公司包括Apollo、Blue Owl、Carlyle、Neuberger等。此举是在美国总统Donald Trump一年前签署行政令、为401(k)账户投资另类资产打开大门之后作出的。

headline.en: Private credit M&A continues through 2026, led by CVC-Marathon deal
headline.zh: 私募信贷整合在2026年持续，以CVC-马拉松交易开局

summary.en: Private credit mergers and acquisitions continued in 2026, starting with CVC's purchase of global credit manager Marathon for $1.2bn, which lifts CVC Credit's fee-paying assets under management to approximately €61bn. Later deals included Nuveen's £9.9bn agreement to acquire Schroders, Bridgepoint's roughly $1.4bn purchase of Kayne Anderson Real Estate, Sun Life's C$829m payment for the remaining 49 per cent of Crescent Capital Group, and Lazard's $575m acquisition of Campbell Lutyens.
summary.zh: 私募信贷并购在2026年持续推进，开局是CVC以12亿美元收购全球信贷管理公司马拉松，使CVC Credit的收费资产管理规模增至约610亿欧元。随后的交易包括Nuveen以99亿英镑收购Schroders的协议、Bridgepoint以约14亿美元收购Kayne Anderson Real Estate、Sun Life支付8.29亿加元收购Crescent Capital Group剩余49%股权，以及Lazard以5.75亿美元收购Campbell Lutyens。

headline.en: Bridge launches $500m direct lending fund for US retail suppliers
headline.zh: Bridge 推出 5 亿美元直接贷款基金，面向美国零售供应商

summary.en: Bridge, a Citi-backed AI-powered lending platform, has launched a $500m direct lending fund for US retail suppliers. The fund targets consumer packaged goods brands and retail suppliers in the US. Bridge spun out of Citi in 2023 and has since deployed more than $800m to businesses.
summary.zh: 由 Citi 支持的 AI 驱动贷款平台 Bridge 已推出一只 5 亿美元的直接贷款基金，面向美国零售供应商。该基金瞄准美国的消费品包装品牌和零售供应商。Bridge 于 2023 年从 Citi 分拆，此后已向企业投放超过 8 亿美元。

headline.en: Apollo funds to sell Kelvion to SLB for $4.1 billion
headline.zh: Apollo旗下基金将以41亿美元向SLB出售Kelvion

summary.en: Apollo announced that SLB has entered a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Kelvion, a thermal management and cooling solutions company, for approximately $3.4 billion in cash plus about $0.7 billion of assumed debt. Kelvion is majority owned by Apollo-managed funds, with funds advised by Triton holding a minority interest that SLB will also acquire.
summary.zh: Apollo宣布，SLB已达成最终协议，将以约34亿美元现金加上约7亿美元承担债务，收购热管理及冷却解决方案公司Kelvion 100%股权。Kelvion目前由Apollo管理的基金持有多数股权，Triton顾问的基金持有少数股权，SLB也将一并收购。

headline.en: Mortgage Rates Stay Above 6% as Multifamily Investors See Upside
headline.zh: 抵押贷款利率维持在6%以上，多户住宅投资者看到上行空间

summary.en: The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate was 6.66 percent for the week ending Aug. 27, per the latest Freddie Mac survey, up from 6.56 percent a year earlier. J.P. Morgan Asset Management's Chad Tredway said higher-for-longer borrowing costs are pushing more households into rentals and keeping them there longer.
summary.zh: 根据最新的房利美调查，截至8月27日当周，30年期固定抵押贷款平均利率为6.66%，高于去年同期的6.56%。摩根大通资产管理公司的Chad Tredway表示，长期维持高位的借贷成本正推动更多家庭转向租赁住房，并使其停留更长时间。

headline.en: Homestead holds first close of inaugural agriculture private credit fund
headline.zh: Homestead首只农业私人信贷基金完成首次募集

summary.en: Homestead Capital announced the first close of its inaugural agriculture private credit fund, anchored by a $150m commitment from a large US state pension system's private credit investment team. The fund is targeting a total raise of $350m with a $500m hard cap, and will originate senior secured loans collateralised by farmland and other agricultural assets to US agricultural borrowers. Earlier this year Homestead and Barings formed a partnership initiated with a $300m forward-flow agreement.
summary.zh: Homestead Capital宣布其首只农业私人信贷基金完成首次募集，锚定投资来自一家大型美国州养老金体系的私人信贷投资团队，金额为1.5亿美元。该基金目标总募集规模为3.5亿美元，硬性上限为5亿美元，将向美国农业借款人发放以农田及其他农业资产为抵押的优先担保贷款。今年早些时候，Homestead与Barings建立合作，以一项3亿美元的前向流动协议启动。

headline.en: Standard Life Projects Private Credit Share of UK DC Private Market Allocations at 20-40% by 2035
headline.zh: Standard Life预测：到2035年私募信贷将占英国DC私募市场配置的20%至40%

summary.en: Standard Life and WPI Economics projected that private market allocations in UK defined contribution default funds could rise from around 2 to 4 per cent today to between 15 and 30 per cent by 2035, with private credit making up 20 to 40 per cent of those allocations. The report also projected consolidation leaving 10 to 15 larger schemes each managing more than £50bn, and estimated between £40bn and £200bn of DC pension assets.
summary.zh: Standard Life与WPI Economics预测，英国固定缴费（DC）默认基金的私募市场配置可能从目前的约2%至4%，到2035年升至15%至30%，其中私募信贷将占这些配置的20%至40%。报告还预计市场整合后将剩下10至15家规模更大的养老金计划，每家管理资产超过500亿英镑，并估计将有400亿至2000亿英镑的DC养老金资产。

headline.en: LACERA appoints Cheyne Capital to manage $750m credit mandate
headline.zh: LACERA 委任 Cheyne Capital 管理 7.5 亿美元信贷授权

summary.en: The Los Angeles County Employees' Retirement Association has appointed Cheyne Capital Management to oversee a multi-asset credit mandate of up to $750m through a dedicated managed account vehicle. The investment was disclosed in a report from a LACERA Board of Investments meeting last month. LACERA manages $93.9bn in assets and its credit portfolio has a target allocation of 13 per cent.
summary.zh: Los Angeles County Employees' Retirement Association 已委任 Cheyne Capital Management 管理一项多资产信贷授权，通过一个专项管理账户工具投资最高 7.5 亿美元。该投资在 LACERA 投资委员会上月一份会议报告中披露。LACERA 管理资产规模为 939 亿美元，其信贷组合的目标配置比例为 13%。

headline.en: Apollo, BDT & MSD Provide $197M Construction Loan for Naples Condos
headline.zh: Apollo与BDT & MSD提供1.97亿美元贷款，用于建设那不勒斯豪华公寓

summary.en: Kolter Urban and BH Group have secured $197 million in construction financing from Apollo Global Management and BDT & MSD Partners to build Olana Naples Residences in Naples, Florida. The project will have 12 estate-style condominiums of about 10,000 square feet each, with the least expensive unit priced at $32 million. Groundbreaking is planned before the end of 2026, with completion targeted for 2028.
summary.zh: Kolter Urban和BH Group已从Apollo Global Management和BDT & MSD Partners获得1.97亿美元建设融资，用于在佛罗里达州那不勒斯开发Olana Naples Residences。该项目将建12套约1万平方英尺的庄园式公寓，最低价单元售价3200万美元。开发商计划在2026年底前动工，目标2028年完工。

headline.en: Andalusian Credit Partners deploys $200m in Q2 2026, its most active quarter
headline.zh: Andalusian Credit Partners 在 2026 年第二季度部署 2 亿美元，为迄今最活跃季度

summary.en: Andalusian Credit Partners deployed $200m across 22 investments in the second quarter of 2026, its most active quarter to date. Ten of the investments were in new portfolio companies and 12 in existing commitments. Chief executive and chief investment officer Aaron Kless cited particular opportunity in specialty services.
summary.zh: Andalusian Credit Partners 在 2026 年第二季度通过 22 笔投资部署了 2 亿美元，为其迄今最活跃的季度。其中 10 笔投向新投资组合公司，12 笔为现有承诺。首席执行官兼首席投资官 Aaron Kless 表示，专业服务领域尤其存在机会。

headline.en: OTF closes $150 million private placement of 7.60% senior unsecured notes due 2032
headline.zh: OTF完成1.5亿美元7.60%于2032年到期的优先无担保票据私募发行

summary.en: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. (NYSE: OTF) closed a private placement of $150 million aggregate principal amount of 7.60% senior unsecured notes due September 3, 2032. The company said this was its third financing since June 30, 2026, bringing total debt capital raised during the period to $800 million. In August OTF issued an additional $400 million of its 6.500% notes due 2029 and raised $250 million through a special purpose vehicle facility secured by a pool of portfolio investments.
summary.zh: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp.（NYSE: OTF）完成了本金总额1.5亿美元、利率7.60%、于2032年9月3日到期的优先无担保票据私募发行。公司表示，这是其自2026年6月30日以来的第三次融资，使该期间筹集的债务资本总额达到8亿美元。8月，OTF额外发行了4亿美元于2029年到期的6.500%票据，并通过一只由投资组合资产池担保的特殊目的载体工具筹集了2.5亿美元。

headline.en: Bain Capital Private Credit Group reports $6 billion of first-half 2026 financing investments
headline.zh: 贝恩资本私人信贷集团公布2026年上半年60亿美元融资投资

summary.en: Bain Capital's Private Credit Group said it invested approximately $6 billion in the first half of 2026 across 58 investments supporting refinancing, leveraged buyout and add-on acquisition activity. The group closed over $2.2 billion of new capital during the period and managed approximately $24 billion of capital as of June 30, 2026.
summary.zh: 贝恩资本私人信贷集团表示，2026年上半年投资约60亿美元，完成58笔投资，用于支持再融资、杠杆收购及附加收购活动。该集团期内募集超过22亿美元新资本，截至2026年6月30日管理约240亿美元资本。

headline.en: ICE launches private credit reference data service
headline.zh: ICE推出私人信贷参考数据服务

summary.en: Intercontinental Exchange has launched ICE Private Credit Reference Data, a reference data service for private credit instruments. The service builds on the recent launch of ICE IDs, which ICE describes as the first foundational identifiers for private credit.
summary.zh: 洲际交易所（ICE）推出了ICE Private Credit Reference Data，一项面向私人信贷工具的参考数据服务。该服务建立在近期推出的ICE IDs基础之上，ICE称ICE IDs是私人信贷的首批基础标识符。

headline.en: Fasanara and Tether launch $400m private credit fund
headline.zh: Fasanara与Tether推出4亿美元私募信贷基金

summary.en: Fasanara Capital and stablecoin issuer Tether have launched the Tether-Fasanara Lending Fund, a $400m jointly sponsored evergreen private credit vehicle. The fund targets up to $3bn in third-party institutional capital and embeds USD₮ into consumer and SME lending flows. Fasanara acts as investment manager and Tether as co-sponsor, originator and adviser.
summary.zh: Fasanara Capital与稳定币发行方Tether已推出Tether-Fasanara Lending Fund，这是一只规模4亿美元、联合发起的常青私募信贷工具。该基金目标募集最高30亿美元的第三方机构资本，并将USD₮嵌入消费者和中小企业贷款流程。Fasanara担任投资管理人，Tether担任联合发起方、发起人和顾问。

headline.en: KKR files 8-K after report of $250 million settlement and reimbursement
headline.zh: KKR在2.5亿美元和解及报销报道后提交8-K文件

summary.en: KKR & Co. Inc. entered a Stipulation and Order with the Department of Justice Antitrust Division on August 26, 2026 to resolve a civil antitrust complaint filed January 14, 2025 over premerger notification requirements for 2021 and 2022 transactions. A KKR subsidiary would pay $250.0 million to the Antitrust Division, and the Antitrust Division terminated all related investigations into KKR and its affiliates. KKR said the civil penalty will have no financial impact on the firm, its funds or its investors and will be fully reimbursed by outside law firms.
summary.zh: KKR & Co. Inc.于2026年8月26日与美国司法部反垄断司签订和解协议与命令，以解决2025年1月14日就其2021年和2022年交易的合并前申报要求提起的民事反垄断诉讼。KKR的一家子公司将向反垄断司支付2.5亿美元，反垄断司终止了对KKR及其关联公司的所有相关调查。KKR表示该民事罚款不会对公司、其基金或投资者产生财务影响，并将由外部律师事务所全额报销。

headline.en: New York Office Tower Listings Test Market Recovery After 2025 Investment Surge
headline.zh: 纽约办公大楼挂牌潮考验市场复苏，2025年投资额增长30%

summary.en: In a two-week period this July, three Midtown office towers were put up for sale: BXP's ground lease at 7 Times Square asking more than $700 million, Empire State Realty Trust's 1359 Broadway seeking roughly $225 million, and Property & Building Corporation's 10 Bryant Park looking for more than $800 million. August listings included Tishman Speyer's 6 Grand Central at about $450 million and China Life Insurance Group's minority stake in RXR's 1285 Sixth Avenue. Manhattan office sales in the second quarter totaled $2.3 billion, up 42 percent year over year, after 2025 office investment grew 30 percent to exceed $11 billion.
summary.zh: 今年7月的两周内，三座中城办公大楼挂牌出售：BXP位于时代广场7号的土地租赁权要价超过7亿美元，Empire State Realty Trust的百老汇1359号寻求约2.25亿美元，Property & Building Corporation的布莱恩特公园10号在2022年一笔8.55亿美元交易失败后再次挂牌，要价超过8亿美元。8月的挂牌包括Tishman Speyer的中央车站6号，要价约4.5亿美元，以及中国人寿保险集团出售其在RXR第六大道1285号A级大楼中的少数股权。曼哈顿第二季度办公楼销售额总计23亿美元，同比增长42%，此前2025年办公楼投资增长30%，超过110亿美元。

headline.en: GPs turn to NAV loans as fundraising market stays tough
headline.zh: 募资市场艰难，GP转向NAV贷款

summary.en: Net asset value financing is gaining ground across private equity on both sides of the Atlantic, with lenders reporting broader use cases beyond early applications. Arcmont's Peter Hutton said roughly 40 per cent of mid-market PE managers in Europe have already executed a NAV loan, versus around 30 per cent in the US. 17Capital partner David Wilson said adoption continues to rise among sophisticated sponsors in both regions, mainly to create fund-level investment capacity.
summary.zh: 资产净值（NAV）融资在私募股权行业持续升温，大西洋两岸采用率上升，贷款机构报告称用途已超出早期应用范围。Arcmont的Peter Hutton表示，欧洲约40%的中端市场私募股权管理人已执行过NAV贷款，美国约为30%。17Capital合伙人David Wilson表示，两个地区最成熟的发起人采用率持续上升，主要目的是在基金层面创造投资能力。

headline.en: Congress passes 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act with over 40 housing incentives
headline.zh: 美国国会通过21世纪ROAD住房法案，包含40多项住房激励措施

summary.en: Congress passed the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act into law on July 11, with bipartisan majorities of 85-5 in the Senate and 358-32 in the House. The law combines more than 40 economic incentives, regulatory reforms and updates to federal laws aimed at spurring construction of affordable housing, single-family homes and manufactured housing; industry experts say it lacks teeth where most US housing development policy happens. J.P. Morgan Chase estimated a US housing shortage of 2.8 million units, while the U.S. Chamber of Commerce put the shortfall at 4.7 million homes.
summary.zh: 美国国会于7月11日通过21世纪ROAD住房法案，参议院以85票对5票、众议院以358票对32票的两党多数通过。该法案结合了40多项经济激励、监管改革及联邦法律更新，旨在推动可负担住房、单户住宅和预制住房的建设；行业专家称其在 most US housing development policy 所在的层面缺乏约束力。摩根大通估计美国住房短缺280万套，而美国商会认为缺口为470万套。
